house.description: Community Mediation Minnesota funding provided for a statewide housing mediation program, and money appropriated.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Housing Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to housing; appropriating money to Community Mediation Minnesota for a statewide housing mediation program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$2,200,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $2,200,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Minnesota Housing Finance Agency for a grant to Community Mediation Minnesota to administer a statewide housing mediation program to support renters and residential rental property owners. The program must: +]

[+(1) provide housing dispute resolution services to renters and rental property owners and homeowners; +]

[+(2) increase awareness of and access to housing dispute resolution services statewide; +]

[+(3) provide dispute resolution services, including but not limited to eviction prevention, mediation, and navigation services; +]

[+(4) partner with culturally specific dispute resolution programs to provide training and assistance with virtual and in-person mediation and resolution services; +]

[+(5) increase mediation services for seniors and renters with disabilities and illnesses who face housing instability; +]

[+(6) increase the diversity and cultural competency of the housing mediator roster; +]

[+(7) integrate housing mediation services with navigation and resource connection services, legal assistance, and court services programs; +]

[+(8) continue to develop and administer evaluation tools to design, modify, and replicate effective program outcomes; and +]

[+(9) provide for necessary administrative expenses. +]
additions: APPROPRIATION.

$2,200,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $2,200,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Minnesota Housing Finance Agency for a grant to Community Mediation Minnesota to administer a statewide housing mediation program to support renters and residential rental property owners. The program must:
(1) provide housing dispute resolution services to renters and rental property owners and homeowners;
(2) increase awareness of and access to housing dispute resolution services statewide;
(3) provide dispute resolution services, including but not limited to eviction prevention, mediation, and navigation services;
(4) partner with culturally specific dispute resolution programs to provide training and assistance with virtual and in-person mediation and resolution services;
(5) increase mediation services for seniors and renters with disabilities and illnesses who face housing instability;
(6) increase the diversity and cultural competency of the housing mediator roster;
(7) integrate housing mediation services with navigation and resource connection services, legal assistance, and court services programs;
(8) continue to develop and administer evaluation tools to design, modify, and replicate effective program outcomes; and
(9) provide for necessary administrative expenses.
